task_text: Find the measuring cup and put it in the bin, then find the dish brush and put it in the bin. Each target counts when its centre is inside the bin (within 0.056 m x 0.052 m of the bin's centre along the bin's horizontal axes and at most 0.26 m above its floor) while it is the current target: first the measuring cup, then the dish brush. Success: every target has counted (a counted target may leave the bin again). Distractors in the bin do not matter. The goal must hold for 30 consecutive control steps (1.02 s); the episode then ends in success.
